name: custos_budget
comment: The budget roll-up of the governor's meter (charter 8.3, TPS 5.3.31): one row per horizon (hour, day, thirty_days), written by the job custosBudget, with the pressure level pcalc governor pressure_level answered at that roll-up.

columns.name: cb_use
columns.comment: CPU use over the horizon, thousandths of a CPU second

columns.name: cb_requests
columns.comment: The governed requests over the horizon

columns.name: cb_rolled
columns.comment: The server time of the roll-up, whole seconds

columns.name: cb_level
columns.comment: The PRESSURE LEVEL in force at the roll-up, the Calculator's word

columns.name: cb_kept
columns.comment: The level the hysteresis keeps, the next update's prev
